name: JavaScript: Missing function argument
mistake: Student called function with only one argument instead of two

request.userInput:
const add = (a, b) => a + b;
console.log(add(3));
request.description: Write an arrow function named add that takes two parameters a and b and returns their sum. Then call the function with arguments 3 and 4.

hints.text: The function should be called with two arguments.
Both parameters a and b should be passed when calling the function.
The function call should use add(3, 4).
